{"metadata":{"description":"An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page annotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop.","id":"gh:1342037109","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-browser","slug":"Nono-neko/dsh-browser","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-desktop","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"An AI-native browser workspace for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), combining multi-tab browsing, live page a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nnotations, lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web an"},{"id":"p1s3","text":", lightweight code editing, workspace previews, and Agent-assisted iteration across Web and Desktop."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Browser"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Embedded browser for the DSH Web GUI: browse the web and your workspace files
> inside the chat in"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"terface — multi-tab, address bar, per-workspace tab
> persistence, page-region review comments, and "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"a lightweight workspace
> editor — plus agent tools (`browser_open`, `browser_read`, `browser_review"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"`). Pages are
> rendered by a headless Chromium (Puppeteer) on the host, so sites that send
> `X-Fra"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"me-Options` load correctly."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"An external plugin package for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It is a single
dual-face cordis bundle: the h"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ost half owns the agent tools, the
`/api/dsh-browser` route family (Puppeteer page proxy + SSE open-"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"event stream
+ workspace file listing/serving/editing + review storage), the settings namespace, and"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" the
system-prompt announcement; the browser half renders the sidebar entry, the
multi-tab panel, an"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"d the plugin settings card. Hot-pluggable — mounted via
`dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:<repo>"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"the plugin settings card. Hot-pluggable — mounted via
`dsh plugin --profile <name> add link:<repo>`."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Platform support.** Version 0.4.1 requires DSH v0.2.0-rc.1 or later with
> ConfigForms and volat"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ile Config APIs on Web and Desktop. The visual settings form works on both platforms —
> no DSH sour"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ce changes needed. On Web it appears under Settings → Plugins; on
> Desktop it appears as a standalo"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"ne "Embedded browser" entry in the left nav."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A Chromium-based browser must be installed on the host machine (Chrome,
Edge, or Chromium). The plug"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"in auto-detects the executable on Windows, macOS,
and Linux; you can also set an explicit path in th"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e settings card. The plugin
uses `puppeteer-core` (not `puppeteer`), so it never downloads its own
C"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"gs card. The plugin
uses `puppeteer-core` (not `puppeteer`), so it never downloads its own
Chromium."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Entry**: a "Browser" row in the sidebar, below the New Session button.
- **Update notifications*"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"*: a separate button next to Browser shows "Update
available" when a newer version is available for "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"that installation source.
It opens version details,
release notes, manual checking, update guidance,"},{"id":"p10s4","text":" and ignore/restore controls
without navigating or reloading the preview. This feature only notifies"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"; it
never installs packages, modifies files, or restarts the Host.
- **Panel**: takes over the cent"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"er column with a tab strip, a toolbar
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **Loopback fence**: every `/api/dsh-browser` route (proxy, SSE, files,
preview-session negotiation"},{"id":"p12s2","text":", review screenshots, source editing, reviews,
and update metadata)
refuses non-loopback clients (so"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"cket address + Host header + same-origin
markers). A LAN-exposed dsh web cannot serve workspace file"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"s or the proxy
to unpaired devices.
- **Desktop preview carrier**: Desktop's native capability heade"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"r is deliberately
unavailable inside opaque sandbox frames. The authenticated parent therefore
negot"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"iates an on-demand HTTP listener bound only to `127.0.0.1` and moves only
iframe `GET` requests for "},{"id":"p12s7","text":"proxy/file content to a random 256-bit path on that
listener. The capability is process-memory-only,"},{"id":"p12s8","text":" responses use
`Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, unknown paths are denied, and the listener is
closed "},{"id":"p12s9","text":"with the plugin routes. It does not expose mutation, SSE, settings, or
other DSH APIs and does not e"},{"id":"p12s10","text":"nable Desktop's ordinary-browser access. Workspace
paths still pass through the normal workspace gat"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"e and per-preview resource
capability checks.
- **Workspace gate**: file listing, serving, review sc"},{"id":"p12s12","text":"reenshots, review storage, and source editing canonicalize the requested root
(realpath) and require"},{"id":"p12s13","text":" it to be a registered workspace or inside one;
every requested path is re-checked after resolution,"},{"id":"p12s14","text":" so symlinks cannot
escape the root.
- **Update metadata boundary**: `GET /api/dsh-browser/updates` "},{"id":"p12s15","text":"reads a cached
snapshot; `POST /api/dsh-browser/updates/check` requests a rate-limited refresh.
Both"},{"id":"p12s16","text":" enforce the same loopback fence, but need no workspace because they never
read project files. Outbo"},{"id":"p12s17","text":"und requests use only fixed HTTPS endpoints at
`registry.npmjs.org` and `api.github.com`, refuse red"},{"id":"p12s18","text":"irects, and are capped at
10 seconds and 512 KiB per response. No workspace paths, source contents,
"},{"id":"p12s19","text":"credentials, or comments are sent. The package version is sent as User-Agent;
optional repository tr"},{"id":"p12s20","text":"acking also sends the plugin's built commit for comparison.
Release notes are untrusted plain text, "},{"id":"p12s21","text":"not HTML or Agent instructions. Links
are constructed from fixed repository/package URLs, never remo"},{"id":"p12s22","text":"te-provided URLs.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **No persistent login**: each proxied page opens a fresh Puppeteer page and
closes it after render"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ing. Cookies and login state are not retained between
requests, so sites that require authentication"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" will show a logged-out view.
- **GET only**: the panel proxy supports GET requests. Form submission"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"s (POST)
and file uploads are not proxied — they will execute inside the iframe and
may be blocked b"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"y the target site's `X-Frame-Options`.
- **JavaScript-rendered navigation**: the initial page is ful"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ly rendered by
Puppeteer, but subsequent in-page navigation (SPA routing, form posts)
happens inside"},{"id":"p14s7","text":" the iframe and may hit `X-Frame-Options` on the new URL.
Ordinary `<a>` links are intercepted and r"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"e-proxied.
- **`browser_read` sees only static HTML**: JavaScript-rendered pages come
back without t"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"heir client-side content, and it cannot use your logins.
- **Live DOM target selection is workspace-"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"only**: proxied development-server
pages still use screenshot/coordinate selection, so their transie"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"nt animation
state may not match an attachment captured later.
- **Workspace handoff screenshots are"},{"id":"p14s12","text":" a fresh headless render**: they do not
reload or move the visible iframe, but transient animation a"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"nd scroll state in
the attachment can differ from the live state where the user clicked. The
structu"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"red selector, click point, and selection-time scroll remain authoritative.
- **Review storage is not"},{"id":"p14s15","text":" persistent yet**: comments and batches are cleared
when the DSH host restarts.
- **Browsing consume"},{"id":"p14s16","text":"s real network traffic** on the host machine."}],"truncated":true}
